WITH pack_edges AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) SELECT DISTINCT dp.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, cp.pack_number AS cr_pack, cp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting FROM document AS d JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack AS cp ON cp.id = pe.pack_id JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = d.id JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id WHERE d.number = 'R3-226125' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.evidence_status), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'sourceverified' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.scope), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('wholedocument', 'document') AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'ran3';

WITH pack_edges AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), section_edges AS (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) SELECT DISTINCT dp.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, cp.pack_number AS cr_pack, cp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, s.clause AS clause FROM document AS d JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack AS cp ON cp.id = pe.pack_id JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = d.id JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id JOIN section_edges AS se ON se.cr = d.id JOIN section AS s ON s.id = se.section_id WHERE d.number = 'R3-207256' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.evidence_status), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'sourceverified' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.scope), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('wholedocument', 'document') AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'ran3' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.spec)), '3GPP', ''), 'TS', ''), ' ', '') = '38.473';

WITH RECURSIVE pack_edges AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member), origin(id) AS (SELECT id FROM document WHERE number = 'R3-212932'), descendants(id) AS (SELECT rev.later FROM revision AS rev JOIN origin AS o ON rev.earlier = o.id UNION SELECT rev.later FROM revision AS rev JOIN descendants AS previous ON rev.earlier = previous.id) SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS final_document, dp.code AS disposition, cp.pack_number AS cr_pack FROM document AS d JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack AS cp ON cp.id = pe.pack_id JOIN descendants AS descendant ON descendant.id = d.id JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = d.id JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.evidence_status), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'sourceverified' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.scope), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) IN ('wholedocument', 'document') AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'ran3' AND d.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM origin);
